description: We are six curious minds who believe every big discovery starts with a young explorer looking up at the sky.Our team came together around one idea: space science shouldn't feel like a textbook. It should feel like an adventure. So we built a game where students launch a rocket, build a home on Mars, and follow the trail of NASA's Opportunity rover, a little explorer built for 90 days that worked almost 15 years.
summary:
Every frontier begins with a question: what lies beyond the horizon? In our game, young students answer it as junior astronauts. With Astra, a little robot companion, they build a rocket and launch for Mars, the next frontier of human exploration. On the red planet they build an outpost, making oxygen, powering the habitat, growing food and surviving a solar storm, just as future crews will have to.
Then a mystery calls them deeper into the frontier. NASA's Opportunity rover, built for 90 days but working almost 15 years, has gone silent. By following tracks, scanning ancient rocks and crossing a dust storm, students find Oppy at sunset and learn how past explorers opened the way for the next ones.
details: Astral Agents: Astra and the Red Frontier is a mobile-friendly 2D game that trains students as junior astronauts across three missions. In Launch Day, students install rocket parts, learn what each does, and launch. In Mars Outpost, they walk a Martian map with a joystick and action button, and keep oxygen, power, food and radiation protection balanced while a solar storm hits. In Finding Oppy, they follow clues across Mars, scan rover tracks and rocks, cross a dust storm using a minimap, and find NASA's Opportunity rover. A final cinematic and "Oppy's Memory Archive" close the story. Astra, a robot companion, guides each mission with short hints
